Summaries

five sample summaries

[1] He talks about poverty and poor people. He explained that poor people do not make bad situations. Because they are stupid or lazy. Poverty creates a scarcity mentality that makes it difficult to think about the future. For example sugarcane farmers in India. They are worse on IQ tests when they are poor. He said that poor people need a basic income.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
[2] This TED talk, poverty isn`t a lack of character, it`s a lack of cash challenges the common idea that poor people are poor because they make bad decisions or have weak character. He explains that poverty can change the way people think and make decisions. One important idea in the talk is the scarcity mentality. When people do not have enough money, food, or time, they have to focus on their immediate problems. Because of this, it can become difficult to think about long term goals. Bregman gives an example of sugarcane farmers in India. The farmers performed worse on IQ tests before their harvest, when they had less money, than after the harvest. He uses this example to explain how financial stress can affect people`s mental ability. He also talks about basic income, which gives people enough money to meet their basic needs. He describes an experiment in Dauphin, Canada, where people were guaranteed a basic income. Bregman argues that reducing poverty should focus more on changing people`s economic situation than on trying to change their character.
[3] In this TED Talk, Rutger Bregman talks about poverty. He explains that poverty is not caused by a lack of character, but by a lack of money. Many people think poor people are poor because they are lazy or make bad choices. However, Bregman says this is not always true. He explains the idea of “scarcity mentality.” When people do not have enough money, they have to worry about many things, such as food, bills, and housing. This stress makes it harder to think about the future and make good decisions. He also introduces some experiments about poverty. These experiments show that giving people money can improve their lives and help them make better decisions. Bregman also talks about basic income as one possible way to reduce poverty. He believes we should change the way we think about poor people. Poverty is not simply a personal problem. It is also connected to the society people live in. His main message is that people need money and security to have more control over their lives.                                                                       
[4] This video shows why people are poor, why they make the wrong decision, and what is the solution for no poverty. The speaker mentioned the traits of poor people who smoke more, exercising less, and drinking more. And he said about their IQ, their IQ less than 4.4 pt. Based on this, he showed the graph regarding schooling and income. That said that schooling brought rising income for the future. By doing his solution, 500 billion$ that the costs of child poverty in the U.S. can reduce 175 billion$ that the cost to end poverty in the U.S.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
[5] In this TED talk, historian Rutger Bregman explains that poverty is caused by a lack of money, rather than a lack of personal character. Many people mistakenly believe that poor individuals make bad choices due to their own personal faults. However, studies show that financial stress and constant worry overload the human brain, making it much harder to think clearly or plan for the future. When people do not have enough money, their minds are completely focused on immediate survival.To truly solve this problem, Bregman suggests using a basic income guarantee. This means giving people unconditional monthly cash to easily cover their basic needs, such as food, shelter, and education, without any strict rules or judgment. By offering direct financial support instead of traditional, complicated welfare systems, society can give people the dignity and resources they need to escape poverty and fully improve their lives.

Opinions

five sample opinions

[1]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
[2] I thought this was a very interesting topic because I recently had an opportunity to think about poverty in one of my classes. I had never thought that poverty could affect people’s ability to make decisions. I agree that it is difficult to think about the future when people are worried about money and basic needs. However, I think basic income alone may not solve every problem. People may also need education and other kinds of support. I think we should try to understand the reasons behind people’s choices instead of simply blaming them.     
[3] I really agree with the speaker's main idea. Many people think poor people are lazy, but poverty actually makes it hard to think clearly. If we give everyone enough money to live, people can spend time on good work and better lives. Basic income guarantee is a very smart solution for our future.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
[4]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
[5] I also believe that the most important thing in life is not to work for a company, but to live for myself. Recently, we tend to live without gals. It causes a decrease of a passion for life. I was surprised that the farmer's intelligence decreased because of alcohol or a shortage of sleeping time. I think this indicates that earning a lot of money is not so important for life. And even if they don’t have to have a lot of money to buy brand-name goods or live a wealthy life, if you can earn enough money for enough to make a living is happiness.
